line.a_piekarnia.text: I'm opening a forest bakery! I've baked the first rolls.

line.a_ile.text: How many rolls are on the tray? Count them, touching each one in turn.

line.a_piec.text: Five rolls! The last number tells how many there are.

line.a_rozloze.text: I'll spread them along the whole counter, to look nice.

line.a_wiecej.text: Oh, now there are more! They take up so much room!

line.a_policz.text: Bear, did more rolls appear? Let's count again.

line.a_dalej_piec.text: Still five! When we spread things out, there aren't more of them.

line.a_rozumiem.text: Five is five, close together or far apart. I see!

line.a_karteczka.text: Someone slipped a note under the door! There's a feather on it. It's from Owl!

line.a_karteczka_ile.text: It's an order! Owl drew how many rolls she wants. Let's count them, then I'll know how many to pack. Point to each roll in the drawing, one by one.

line.a_spakuj.text: Put four rolls into the bag. Drag them one at a time and I'll count.

line.a_za_duzo.text: That's four already! No more needed.

line.a_cztery.text: Four rolls for Owl, just right!

line.b_jablka.text: I need five apples for the apple pie.

line.b_ktora.text: Where are five apples? Point to them.

line.b_ktora_nie.text: Count again. We're looking for five.

line.b_piec_twarzy.text: Five can be shown in many ways. For example with dots on a domino.

line.b_domino.text: Which domino has five dots altogether? Point to it.

line.b_domino_nie.text: Count all the dots on that domino, at the top and at the bottom.

line.b_dwa_i_trzy.text: Two dots and three dots, five altogether!

line.b_skacze.text: I'm jumping for joy! Count my jumps.

line.b_ile_skokow.text: How many times did Hedgehog jump? Point to the number.

line.b_klient.text: Back to the bakery. A customer wants a cookie for five coins. Help them pay.

line.b_zaplacone.text: Five coins, all paid. Thank you!

line.p_start.text: Let's practise counting to five! I have five games.

line.p_ile.text: How many rolls are there? Count and point to the number.

line.p_trzy.text: Put three rolls into the bag.

line.p_taca.text: Which tray has five cookies? Point to it.

line.p_taca_nie.text: Count the cookies. A long row doesn't mean more.

line.p_memory.text: Turn the cards and find pairs: a number and as many dots.

line.p_czwarta.text: Which roll will Hedgehog eat? The fourth from the arrow. Point to it.

line.p_czwarta_nie.text: Count from the arrow: first, second, third, fourth.

line.h_goscie.text: Five guests are coming for supper. Let's set the table!

line.h_kubki.text: Every plate gets one cup. Count the cups.

line.h_po_jednym.text: Five plates and five cups. Every guest has their own!

line.h_rodzice.text: Count five stairs with your parents, and count the plates at the table!

line.naklejka_daj.text: Thank you for helping in the bakery! Here is a sticker for your album. Touch it to take it.

line.naklejka_juz.text: You already have the sticker from this adventure. See you!

line.naklejka_opis.text: This is a roll from Bear's bakery. We got it when we counted to five.
